11. The camera pans to show an empty square concrete box sitting outside near some buildings.
12. Inside someone walks through their living room holding something up high above them.

15. One person sits alone facing away towards windows letting light stream in onto the floor.
16. A man is holding a piece of paper while standing indoors with another person nearby.
17. The same two people are now walking down an outdoor path surrounded by greenery.
18. Two men stand near a building entrance as they walk away together.
19. One individual walks alone along a sidewalk lined with trees.
20. Another group stands outside at night talking to someone inside their vehicle.
21. Three individuals sit around a table having drinks outdoors during evening hours.
22. People gather for what appears to be a social gathering under artificial lighting.
23. Individuals enjoy food and drink at an indoor venue illuminated warmly.
24. A woman sits next to others enjoying beverages at a party setting.
